scientific_integrity: Source 2309.06510 establishes the model, implicit mean-field fixed points, tricritical coordinates and qualitative hysteresis. This result claims a narrower analytic specialization, not discovery of the phenomenon. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the homogeneous scalar six-neighbor signed mean-field rate equation only. Does not establish finite-size random-graph transitions or quantitative behavior for pair/approximate-master closures. Generic tricritical exponent and location are prior work; new claim is explicit model-specific spinodal, sharp quadratic coefficient, exhaustive physical fixed-point classification, and deterministic critical amplitudes.
title: Exact spinodal and quadratic tricritical hysteresis law for signed six-neighbor voting
